chunks: And that when the devotee of God stood up to invoke Him, they (the jinn) crowded upon him.

key_terms.عَبْدُ اللَّهِ: The devotee of God, referring to the Prophet Muhammad

ai.seo_question: How did the jinn react when the Prophet Muhammad stood to recite the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the intense focus of the jinn who listened to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) recite the Quran, particularly during the night of Laylat al-Qadr or when he stood for prayer. The phrase 'libadan' (crowded closely) signifies their eager attention to the divine revelation, underscoring the Quran's power to captivate both human and jinn listeners. This event is often cited to demonstrate the universality of the Prophet's message and the spiritual sensitivity of the jinn to divine speech.
